name: Unaskable
blurb: Questions people want answers to and would never dare ask. Precise, not shocking. For two people who have agreed to this.

howToPlay: Both of you agree to this deck before the first card. Either of you can stop it.
Answer the question that was asked: the name, the number, the order. Deflecting is an answer too; say so out loud.
Start at level one. Go up only when both of you nod.

tiers.name: An accusation with a question mark

cards.text: If I got sick in a way that took years, at what month would you start wishing it were over?
What would I have to do for you to leave, and how close have I already come?
What relief did you feel at a death you were supposed to only be sad about?
What's the sentence about your mother you've never said out loud to anyone?
Whose approval are you still working for, knowing they'll never see any of it?
How much of your loyalty to your oldest friend is dread of the conversation that ends it?
What's the exact sentence about this relationship that shows up at 4am?
What do you know about me that you decided, at some specific moment, never to bring up?
Which of your parents is the bigger coward?
What percentage of your loyalty to your partner is just inertia?
Whose approval are you still trying to win who rarely thinks about you anymore?
Between your mother and father, whose moral failures are you more willing to forgive?
Whose sudden misfortune would secretly make your life a little easier?
Between the two of us, who is settling for the other?
What is the specific reason you think you will eventually outgrow me?
What is the worst thing you genuinely believe about me?
Which part of me do you tolerate because you want to keep me?
Name the person you would least want describing you honestly to this table.
What exact insult from me would hurt because you already believe it?
Rank the three people who love you most by how much of that love you actually return, and explain the one at the bottom.
What's the sentence about me you've composed at 4am and never said?
Rank us: your work, your kids, me. No ties, and tell me what the last twelve months would say if I asked them instead.
Who have you stayed with past the point of loving them, and what month did it end for you?
Which version of me do you actually prefer: the one from five years ago, or this one?
Who would you take back tonight if they asked, and what does it cost you to have said their name in front of me?
Which friend's good news was hardest for you to be happy about?
Who have you already outgrown but haven't told?
Which of your parents would you be quietly relieved to stop having to call every week?
Of the people who raised you, who owes you the apology first, and what's the second one's excuse?
Whose dependence on you do you secretly resent the most?
Put your three biggest life decisions in order of how much they were driven by cowardice.
What percentage of your oldest friendship is affection rather than history?
Who gets the most polished version of you because you trust them least?
Which parent would you choose to know the full truth about you?
Name the person whose affection makes you feel more powerful than loved.
Which person’s happiness have you quietly treated as evidence of your own failure?
Give the exact age when you became less impressive than you expected to be.
Name the person you love whose calls you most often wish you had missed.
What exact sentence about me comes to you at four in the morning?
Name the person your patience is really contempt for.
Whose approval still changes your choices despite your claim that it does not?
How much of your patience with your mother is actually contempt you can't afford to show?
Who did you love more than they loved you, and who is currently on the other side of that arrangement with you?
Whose approval are you still chasing, given they're dead and can't give it?
Who in your family have you already privately decided is a lost cause?
What's the ugliest thought you've had about your own child, word for word?
If my memory of you had to be either honest or kind, which do you want, and why does that answer embarrass you?
Who do you stay patient with purely out of contempt?
When did you last feel relief hearing someone else's bad news, and whose was it?
Whose loyalty do you take for granted because you know it isn't going anywhere?
Which of your two closest friends gets the phone call when your life falls apart, and what's missing in the other one?
Which of your friends' good news did you have to work at being pleased about, and how many days did it take?
Which of your friends would be a little pleased to hear you'd been humiliated in public?
Whose funeral would you skip if the flight were expensive and the week were busy?
Which relationship of yours would survive you being fully honest, and which one would be over by Friday?
Which friend's professional success makes you feel the most insecure?
Between your mother and your father, whose worst trait are you most relieved to not have?
Which of your friendships is sustained primarily by your pity for the other person?
Rank your three oldest friendships by how quickly they would end if you stopped reaching out first.
Rank your siblings by how much you actually enjoy their company right now.
Put your three closest friends in order of whose life you would least want.
Who loves you noticeably more than you love them?
Which parent’s approval still has the higher price in your decisions?
Which former partner understood you better than anyone since?
Whose side do you keep taking mainly because changing your mind would embarrass you?
Whose success is hardest for you to hear about without taking stock of your own life?
For what exact dollar amount would you never speak to me again?
Between your parents, whose funeral will feel more like an obligation than a tragedy?
Rank your children by whose opinion of you has the most power.
Name the friend you love more than they love you.
Which person in your family would you remove to make everyone else closer?
Name the person whose approval still decides what you call success.
Rank the promises you currently keep by how badly you want to break them.
Whose success this year did you have to work hardest to be pleased about?
Which of your two oldest friendships would you let lapse first, and what tipped it?
Which of your two parents do you like less as a person?
Name the friendship you're keeping alive out of habit rather than wanting.
How many people are in your life mainly because leaving would be more effort than staying? Give me the number, then the first name on that list.
Which of your close friends is the most consistently boring to talk to one-on-one?
How much of your reputation for being a good listener is just you enjoying other people's drama?
Which friend's aging makes you feel the most secure about your own appearance?
What percentage of your generosity is just a fear of looking cheap?
Rank your three closest friends by how often you lie to avoid seeing them.
What behavior do you mock in strangers but tolerate in your closest friend?
Rank your three closest friends by how quickly they exhaust your patience.
Which friend's creative work is the hardest for you to pretend to admire?
For what exact dollar amount would you publicly endorse a politician you actively despise?
Whose house or apartment do you leave feeling the most envious?
Rank your siblings by how relieved you feel when each one cancels.
Rank your closest friends by how much their success annoys you.
Name the colleague whose failure would make you feel most vindicated.
Rank the people you have slept with by how embarrassed you would be to resemble them.
Rank your three closest friends by how much you look forward to seeing them, and say what puts the last one last.
Which of your friends' partners do you quietly think they settled for?
Of the people at this table, whose invitation are you most likely to decline next time?
Rank your siblings by whose life you'd least want to swap into, and start with the bottom.
Which friend's texts do you leave the longest, and what makes theirs the ones that wait?
Which opinion of yours is mostly there because of who it annoys?
Who in your life do you find slightly boring but keep seeing anyway?
Rank the people you live with by who you'd most like a week away from.
